title: Preparation of Proteoliposomes
author: Zehra Kahveci
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.rvwd67e

steps.title: Prepare sucrose solution tubes
steps.instruction: Prepare 2 Eppendorf tubes containing 100 µL of 195 mM sucrose solution (freshly made in 5mM Hepes buffer pH 7.4) and add 100 µL of electroformation product into each tube.

steps.title: Dilute membrane transporter
steps.instruction: Dilute the membrane transporter (~5mg/mL) in Poly(ethylene glycol) octyl ether (o-poe) at a 1:1 (v:v) ratio to a total volume of 1µL.

steps.title: Add transporter and control to tubes
steps.instruction: Add the prepared solutions to the respective Eppendorf tubes.

substeps.instruction: Add 1µL of membrane transporter:o-poe 1:1 (v:v) into Eppendorf 1 (SAMPLE).
Shake the SAMPLE and BLANK gently upside-down.

steps.title: Incubate and remove detergent
steps.instruction: Agitate the tubes and add Biobeads to remove detergent.

substeps.instruction: Place both tubes on a shaker and shake at ~600 rpm for 1 hour.
Add 2.5 mg Biobeads into both tubes.

steps.title: Overnight storage
steps.instruction: Store the SAMPLE and BLANK tubes in the fridge at 4°C overnight.

steps.title: Collect proteoliposomes
steps.instruction: Transfer the SAMPLE and BLANK from the original tubes into new Eppendorf tubes using a cut pipette tip.

steps.title: Final agitation and storage
steps.instruction: Perform a final shake and store the samples.

substeps.instruction: Place tubes on a shaker and shake at ~600 rpm for 1 hour.
Store in the fridge; samples can be used within the following 4-5 days.
